test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some cups are glasses.

No cup is a plate.

**Conclusions:**

(i) No glass is a plate.

(ii) Some glasses are not cups.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statements:

Some cups are glasses.

No cup is a plate.

Possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc6c57db4be0972a7bc5685e35527dc447c8c40794b0da5380d18014c062cbf.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) No glass is a plate. → Not Follow ( As there is no direct link between glass and plate)

(ii) Some glasses are not cups.→ Not Follow ( As some cups are glasses, so we can't say that some glass are not cup).

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
